name: signup-04
title: Signup 04
description: A card that opens into two columns: the form, and a kraft panel holding a welcome kit of nine stickers that really peel off. Three provider buttons. The sticker sheet stays home below 42rem. Made for the desk.
docs:
Installed the "Signup 04" block into your components directory under blocks/signup-04/.
Import it: import Signup04Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/signup-04/page"
Needs @hookform/resolvers@^5, react-hook-form@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
